# BTicino C300X Native Agent Integration v0.2.1

Maintenance release focused on the native device-agent update path.

## Highlights

- Separates the Home Assistant integration version from the native C300X
  device-agent version.
- Packages deterministic native-agent bundle metadata with file hashes and a
  stable bundle fingerprint.
- Adds a Home Assistant Repair flow that can update a mismatched installed
  device agent through the existing maintenance API.
- Adds native maintenance endpoints for prepare, chunked upload, verified apply,
  and controlled restart of the device agent.

## Security and Privacy

- Device-agent self-update is explicit and user-confirmed through Repairs.
- No SSH credentials are needed for native-agent updates after the first
  bootstrap install.
- Uploaded files are SHA-256 checked before they are accepted.
- The flow does not run automatically on every Home Assistant start.
